item.title: Federal Reserve lowers interest rate
item.description: Professionals chime on the interest rate cut made by the federal reserve.

item.title: Wilmington man pleads guilty after killing his own family members
item.description: Wilmington man pleads guilty after killing three family members in 2022.

item.title: South Brunswick girls take down West Brunswick 42-30
item.description: Despite no longer being conference rivals, South Brunswick girls basketball knocked off county rival West Brunswick 42-30 on Wednesday.

item.title: South Brunswick gets revenge, knocks off West Brunswick 65-54
item.description: After losing to their county rivals earlier in the season, South Brunswick boys basketball evened the season series by knocking off West Brunswick 65-54 on Wednesday.

item.title: North Brunswick girls fall to J.H. Rose 53-29
item.description: A slow start for North Brunswick girls basketball ultimately ended with a 53-29 home loss to J.H. Rose on Wednesday.

item.title: North Brunswick falls at home to J.H. Rose 88-72
item.description: North Brunswick boys basketball suffered just their second loss of the season on Wednesday when they fell at home to J.H. Rose 88-72.

item.title: Botulism outbreak sickens more than 50 babies and expands to all ByHeart products
item.description: Federal health officials on Wednesday expanded an outbreak of infant botulism tied to recalled ByHeart baby formula to include all illnesses reported since the company began production in March 2022.

item.title: Sophie Kinsella, author of the millions-selling ‘Shopaholic’ novels, dies at 55
item.description: Writer Sophie Kinsella, whose effervescent rom-com “Confessions of a Shopaholic” sparked a millions-selling series, died Wednesday, her family said. She was 55 and had been diagnosed with brain cancer.

item.title: New Hanover Community Endowment holds public meeting to highlight initiatives, grant-making priorities
item.description: More than 100 people gathered for the New Hanover Community Endowment's semi-annual public meeting and listening session, held Wednesday night at Cape Fear Community College's Union Station.

item.title: Welcome Home Angel helps young Leland man be more independent with home improvements
item.description: Manni Dominguez is a 21-year-old man with autism and will now have a bit more independence at home.
